retrieval score

  • CURIE: gmeow:retrievalScore
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/retrievalScore
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/graphrag

Statement-level annotation: the relevance score a retrieval (or re-ranker) assigned to ONE retrievedChunk triple. An annotation property so competing scores coexist attributed (P9) and the OWL downcast stays DL-clean (P3).

Structure

Property shape: annotation property

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:retrievalScore when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
